description: Search live Lobbying Disclosure Act filings from the U.S. Senate LDA database by filing year, client, or registrant. Returns filing type, period, reported income and expenses, registrant, client, and the official document link. This covers Senate LDA filings, not House-only records. Price: 0.01 USDC. Mode: live_source. Source: U.S. Senate Lobbying Disclosure Act database. Set auto_pay=true for a one-call purchase when the local buyer wallet is configured.

auto_pay.description: Automatically authorize and pay this request with the locally configured buyer wallet. Requires X402_AUTO_PAY=true and X402_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.

client_name.description: Name of the entity paying for lobbying.

filing_year.description: Filing year to search. Defaults to the current year.

limit.description: Maximum filings to return, 1 to 25. Defaults to 10.

payment_id.description: payment_id returned by the x402 invoice.

payment_signature.description: Base64 x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE produced by a compatible buyer client.

preview.description: Inspect a rate-limited live contract proof showing source, freshness, response shape, and required inputs. Decision-ready values remain in the paid result.

registrant_name.description: Name of the lobbying firm that filed.

tx_hash.description: Base transaction hash after paying an x402 invoice.

name: lobbying_reports
